title: Cambridge IELTS 14 Test 1 Writing Task 1
directions: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.
prompt: The charts below show the average percentages in typical meals of three types of nutrients, all of which may be unhealthy if eaten too much.
scenario: Three pie charts compare the average percentages of sodium, saturated fat and added sugar in breakfast, lunch, dinner and snacks consumed in the USA.
requirements: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

visualData.title: Average percentages of sodium, saturated fats and added sugars in typical meals consumed in the USA
notes: Saturated fat: Breakfast 16%, Lunch 26%, Dinner 37%, Snacks 21%.
Added sugar: Breakfast 16%, Lunch 19%, Dinner 23%, Snacks 42%.
